rationale: The campaign already has a single controller and a campaign-wide spend cap at recovery_policy.spend_cap_microusd. A run-level cap introduces a second, unspecified budget authority and enforcement rule without a stated use case.
alternatives: Keep it only if the controller must enforce independently configurable per-run budgets; then make it a non-negative integer microusd value and specify its interaction with the campaign cap.
simplestChoice: Use the existing campaign-wide spend cap and remove the run-level field.
